name: Glamdring
subtitle: Lightning Brand
game_text:
Bearer must be Gandalf.
He is <keyword>damage +1</keyword>.
Each time you play a spell during a skirmish, you may make Gandalf <keyword>damage +1</keyword> until the end of that skirmish.
flavor_text: “‘Thunder they heard, and lightning… smote upon Celebdil, and leaped back broken into tongues of fire.’”
